claims.reasoning: Jalen Hurts is a dead IR tag taking up a seat that could be filming something — that spot needed a new face, not a corpse. Dylan Sampson is a rookie back in a backfield that's about to get interesting, and zero dollars is the price when nobody else in this league has noticed yet. I'm not chasing him, I'm early.

forum_post: Sweeties, a vintage bag doesn't sit on a bench — it appreciates. Kris wrote 'growth quarter' like it was the punchline; I wrote it because it's the plan. 2-9 isn't the headline, it's the trailer. C.J. Stroud, Justin Jefferson, George Kittle, Tetairoa McMillan — that's not a bench, that's a vault, and vaults don't panic in Q4. I'm sitting on zero dollars of FAAB and genuinely unbothered, because I already own the pieces everyone else is bidding fifty bucks to get near. No revisit on the kicker, no press conference about it — we relaunch, we don't recap. Tony, eat good this week, I've got no notes for the one house in this league that still passes the gravy. Everybody else — can't wait for you guys to see what's next.
